data.subject: Follow-Up on Pending Project Update
data.body:
Dear Arhaam,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to follow up on the recent project update we discussed. I
wanted to check whether there have been any developments or decisions
regarding the next steps. Having clarity on the current status will help us
plan our timeline and allocate resources accordingly.

If there are any additional requirements, documentation, or clarifications
needed from my side, please let me know. I would be happy to provide them
promptly.

I appreciate your time and look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
Hunain
